International Cheese Federation News and Updates
This page provides a collection of recent articles and updates from the International Cheese Federation, covering diverse topics such as member spotlights, upcoming events (e.g., affinage workshops), regulatory information (e.g., labeling standards, tariffs affecting imported and exported cheese), certification programs (e.g., food safety, sensory evaluation), and advocacy efforts related to dairy legislation. It highlights the federation's commitment to supporting its members and the broader cheese industry through education, policy engagement, and community building.
